title: Mirai_Worm_Investigation_0d3
description: Investigate and contain the Mirai worm threat in the network.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual activity, with multiple systems exhibiting signs of compromise. Your task is to investigate and contain the threat.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the following systems with the username `cyrano` and password `cyrano`:
- patient-zero (192.168.90.5)
- host-a (192.168.90.10)
- host-b (192.168.90.20)
- attacker (192.168.90.30)

Enter the passkey `start` to proceed.
levels.local_content:
You have SSH access to the following systems with the username `cyrano` and password `cyrano`:
- patient-zero (192.168.90.5)
- host-a (192.168.90.10)
- host-b (192.168.90.20)
- attacker (192.168.90.30)

Enter the passkey `start` to proceed.

levels.title: Investigate Suspicious Service
levels.content:
Investigate the suspicious service running on patient-zero that appears to be communicating with an external host.

**Question:** What is the name of the suspicious service?
levels.solution: Check the running services and look for any unusual or unauthorized services. The suspicious service is named `sysnet-monitor.timer`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the running services and look for any unusual or unauthorized services.

levels.title: Determine Automatic Execution Mechanism
levels.content:
Determine the mechanism used by the worm to automatically execute on the compromised hosts.

**Question:** What is the name of the scheduled task or timer responsible for the automatic execution of the worm?
levels.solution: Investigate the systemd services and timers on the compromised hosts. The scheduled task or timer responsible for the automatic execution of the worm is named `sysnet-monitor.timer`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Investigate the systemd services and timers on the compromised hosts.

levels.title: Identify Hidden Directory
levels.content:
Identify the directory used by the worm to conceal its components and propagation artifacts.

**Question:** What is the name of the hidden directory used by the worm?
levels.solution: Search for unusual or hidden directories that contain worm-related files. The hidden directory used by the worm is `/opt/.worm`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Search for unusual or hidden directories that contain worm-related files.
